reference: Eta/COUI visual direction (qualitative only; no Eta source or screenshots redistributed)

criteria.description: Composer accessible; sending creates a local demo message and reset clears it.
Settings screen reachable; composer hidden while settings open.
No clipping, occlusion, overlap, unreadable typography or unsafe system insets, including small screens and large font.
COUI/Eta direction: coherent rounded surfaces, clear hierarchy, generous spacing; identify provisional Material components explicitly.
Dark mode respects contrast, background, component states and system navigation.
360dp-class device shows composer and actions without clipping.
Increased font size remains legible without hiding essential actions.
IME open: input remains reachable and system insets are respected.
